answer.rationale: p99 on the write path has climbed gradually for 90 minutes while settlement writes are at daily peak, which is more consistent with saturation than a clean step-change from the release. Adding headroom is the only candidate that can restore sustained write availability without shedding customer writes. Circuit breaking would fail writes; replica routing addresses report/read offload, not write weight; failover has no regional signal; rollback remains a live alternate hypothesis because a release shipped 2 hours ago, but rolling back mid-settlement is the higher-stakes bet if load is the driver. Verify memory_b3 because that success was pre-peak provisioning, so mid-peak applicability is uncertain.
